slots.research_prompt: system prompt of the investigator node
slots.cutoff_rail: hard research deadline (onTurn inject + preToolUse block)
slots.closure: converts a deadline-hitting run into an answer
slots.output_contract: how the answer leaves the workflow

prompt.seed_persistent.desc: seed's persistent-researcher prompt: vary keywords, reformulate, commit before turns run out

prompt.anchor_scout_v1.desc: High-information-anchor scout that produces an evidence memo rather than an unbounded answer attempt.

prompt.reverse_chain_scout_v1.desc: Outcome-backwards scout that independently narrows candidates and records verification leads.

prompt.exact_integrator_v1.desc: Lead investigator prompt that verifies scout evidence and returns canonical requested forms.

decoding.deterministic_v1.desc: Deterministic deepseek-v4-flash decoding for all three roles.

turn_budget.dual12_plus30_v1.desc: Two 16-turn scouts with a 12-turn research window and one 34-turn integrator with a 30-turn research window.

cutoff.memo_then_commit_v1.desc: Injects a memo/answer deadline and blocks late tool calls so each node can close with usable output.

closure.schema_memo_and_answer_v1.desc: Schema-enforced scout memos and a schema-enforced final answer prevent null returns at turn limits.

output_contract.exact_answer_object_v1.desc: Returns the integrator's exact answer string in the domain answer object.

topology.parallel_scouts_then_integrator.desc: Two independent corpus scouts run in parallel, then a final verifier consumes both compact handoffs.

prompt.hypothesis_lead_v1.desc: Constraint-driven lead investigator that tests a discriminating clue and emits a compact evidence memo.

prompt.canonical_closer_v1.desc: Focused final verifier that resolves exact official, legal, birth-name, and numeric output forms from the lead memo.

turn_budget.lead44_plus12_v1.desc: One 48-turn lead with a 44-turn tool window followed by a 16-turn closer with a 12-turn tool window.

cutoff.lead_memo_then_canonical_v1.desc: Injects a late lead closure reminder and blocks further research before each schema handoff or final commit.

topology.serial_lead_then_canonicalizer_.desc: A single evidence lead hands one compact memo to a bounded canonical-answer closer.

prompt.clue_cartographer_v1.desc: Tool-free planner that extracts compact literal search anchors and a hop-by-hop evidence map.

prompt.chain_investigator_v1.desc: Constraint-led corpus investigator that pivots by rare phrases and distinguishes intermediates from targets.

verifier.forensic_canonical_v1.desc: Focused final verifier that tests the remaining evidence link and canonicalizes names, titles, and values.

turn_budget.plan4_chain34_close12_v1.desc: A four-turn tool-free plan, a 38-turn chain investigator with 34 research turns, and a 16-turn verifier with 12 research turns.

cutoff.chain_audit_then_commit_v1.desc: Closes research after explicit chain and verifier evidence windows so each agent submits structured output.

monitor_rail.chain_evidence_audits_v1.desc: Injects early pivot, target-vs-intermediate, and closure audits into the chain investigator.

closure.plan_memo_answer_schemas_v1.desc: Schema-enforced clue map, evidence memo, and exact answer preserve useful handoffs under deadlines.

topology.serial_clue_map_chain_verifier_.desc: A serial planner → evidence-chain investigator → forensic verifier organization with two compact handoffs.

prompt.literal_anchor_retriever_v1.desc: Independent retriever that searches short rare clauses and traces source wording to the requested final field.

prompt.relational_chain_resolver_v1.desc: Independent constraint-chain researcher that resolves the extra hop from intermediates to the requested answer.

verifier.answer_obligation_v1.desc: Focused final verifier that rejects intermediate entities and checks the exact answer field, form, or calculation.

turn_budget.dual16_26_close12_v1.desc: Two 20/30-turn evidence researchers converge into a 16-turn verifier, with late-turn submission reminders.

monitor_rail.literal_chain_obligation_au.desc: Injects retrieval-pivot, target-field, and required-schema-submission audits before each node closes.

closure.dual_dossier_answer_schemas_v1.desc: Schema-enforced dual evidence dossiers and exact answer preserve useful handoffs at deadlines.

topology.parallel_evidence_then_obligati.desc: Literal and relational evidence specialists work independently in parallel, then converge in a final-field verifier.

prompt.contrast_deadline_lead_v1.desc: Contradiction-first corpus investigator that tests the hardest clue before committing a compact free-text handoff.

prompt.obligation_microcloser_v1.desc: Short final-field closer that performs only decisive canonicalization or calculation checks.

turn_budget.lead22_close7_freeform_v1.desc: A 28-turn lead with a 22-turn research window and a 12-turn closer with a 7-turn verification window.

cutoff.forced_transcript_commit_v1.desc: At each deadline, a nested tool-free editor converts the current transcript into a commitment and stops the search node before maxTurns can erase its handoff.

closure.forced_transcript_final_marker_v.desc: Nested emergency editors emit a FINAL marker from the live transcript, with deterministic extraction after both deadlines.

topology.serial_contrast_lead_microclose.desc: A serial contrast-led investigator hands a compact evidence conclusion to a small final-field closer.

prompt.evidence_lattice_planner_v1.desc: Tool-free planner that converts long questions into short clue-atom joins and candidate-to-field checks.

prompt.evidence_lattice_investigator_v1.desc: Primary constrained-join investigator that records source-grounded candidates, aliases, and final-hop evidence.

verifier.direct_answer_auditor_v1.desc: Final auditor that checks the output obligation, full-name expansion, formal titles, child fields, and report calculations.

turn_budget.lattice4_invest38_audit14_v1.desc: A four-turn planner, 42-turn investigator with a 38-turn research window, and 16-turn direct auditor with a 14-turn tool window.

cutoff.lattice_submit_deadlines_v1.desc: Late submission reminders and hard tool cutoffs preserve a schema handoff and exact final answer.

monitor_rail.lattice_join_audits_v1.desc: Audits retrieval pivots, constraint joins, and canonical final-field checks during research.

closure.lattice_three_schemas_v1.desc: Schema-enforced plan, evidence dossier, and exact answer provide compact handoffs under bounded turns.

topology.serial_lattice_plan_investigate.desc: A serial clue-atom planner to constrained evidence investigator to direct-answer auditor organization.

prompt.literal_evidence_prosecutor_v1.desc: Literal-anchor prosecutor builds a direct-source case file before an emergency commitment deadline.

prompt.reverse_constraint_prosecutor_v1.desc: Output-backwards prosecutor verifies semantic direction and exact output forms in an independent case file.

verifier.cross_examination_arbiter_v1.desc: Adversarial arbiter compares two source case files and checks only the decisive final obligation.

turn_budget.dual18_casefile_plus11_verdi.desc: Two 22-turn prosecutors each commit at turn 18, followed by a 14-turn arbiter committed at turn 11.

cutoff.dual_forced_casefile_v1.desc: Live-transcript case-file editors stop both prosecutors and the arbiter before late tool loops erase their conclusions.

monitor_rail.casefile_cross_examination_.desc: Audits direct source support, final-field direction, and disagreement resolution during every stage.

closure.forced_casefile_final_marker_v1.desc: Tool-free editors turn live transcripts into compact case files and a deterministic FINAL-marker verdict.

topology.parallel_casefiles_then_cross_e.desc: Parallel literal and reverse-constraint prosecutors converge through a focused adversarial cross-examination verdict.

prompt.anchor_ledger_discoverer_v1.desc: Source-first investigator prompt that records proven links and unresolved final hops in a compact evidence ledger.

prompt.final_hop_resolver_v1.desc: Final-field resolver prompt that verifies the missing relational edge and renders the exact requested form.

turn_budget.anchor30_resolve20_commit2_v.desc: Thirty discovery turns and twenty resolution turns, each followed by a two-turn emergency commitment editor.

monitor_rail.anchor_final_edge_audits_v1.desc: Audits source-anchor quality, evidence-versus-unresolved edges, the final relation, and exact output rendering.

topology.serial_anchor_ledger_forced_fin.desc: Serial source-anchor discovery and final-hop resolution, each protected by a tool-free commitment editor.

prompt.hypothesis_divergence_lead_v1.desc: Constraint-divergence lead searches independent literal and inverse routes before emitting a compact evidence memo.

prompt.canonical_recovery_closer_v1.desc: Focused closer rejects intermediate surface matches and resolves exact canonical output forms from a lead memo.

turn_budget.lead44_recovery2_close12_v1.desc: A 48-turn lead with a 44-turn tool window, one two-turn recovery director, and a 16-turn closer with a 12-turn tool window.

cutoff.divergence_memo_then_canonical_v1.desc: Closes the investigator after a rival-aware evidence audit and blocks late lookup loops before both schema commits.

monitor_rail.transcript_recovery_directo.desc: A tool-free director reads the live transcript and injects literal, inverse, and disconfirmation retrieval directions at the recovery checkpoint.

topology.serial_lead_recovery_then_canon.desc: A serial lead investigator is steered by one embedded recovery director, then hands a compact memo to a final canonicalizer.

prompt.literal_source_casefile_v1.desc: Literal-fingerprint investigator that builds a direct-source case file before a forced commitment.

prompt.reverse_final_field_casefile_v1.desc: Independent output-backwards investigator that builds a final-relation case file before commitment.

prompt.casefile_commit_editor_v1.desc: Tool-free editor that converts a live evidence transcript into an exact FINAL-marked commitment.

verifier.casefile_obligation_arbiter_v1.desc: Final arbiter that reconciles divergent case files against the exact answer obligation.

closure.compact_casefile_final_marker_v1.desc: Final-marker extraction returns forced editor commitments when a structured arbiter cannot complete normally.

topology.parallel_casefiles_then_obligat.desc: Parallel literal and output-backwards case files converge into a forced answer-obligation arbiter.
